plate5-lebanon-v158.request_brief: Generate a replacement 'product concept' hero still for the Athar JV pact deck with GPT Image 2.5 at high quality, landscape (widest supported, about 3:2), crop-safe with the key subject centered so it survives wide and phone crops. Theme: 'UAE × Lebanon · 1M Athar users'. Brand: ATHAR navy blue, warm cream and brushed-gold palette; the ATHAR logo shown clearly and exactly as the brand's stylized navy triangular 'A' mark above the uppercase wordmark ATHAR; accurate UAE flag (red, green, white, black) and Lebanese flag (red-white-red bands with a green cedar). The only legible text allowed is 'ATHAR', '1M', 'ATHAR USERS' and 'UAE × LEBANON', spelled exactly, with no gibberish or watermarks. Show dignified, inclusive users (families, a wheelchair user, a blind professional) with correct faces and hands in a premium photoreal visualisation style. (a) Batch three fresh candidates: A) golden-hour Dubai/Abu Dhabi skyline on the left and Beirut coastline with Raouche (Pigeon) Rocks on the right, joined by a luminous gold arc of light across the centre, large ATHAR logo and glowing '1M ATHAR USERS' beneath, small foreground vignette of diverse users on phones and tablets; B) bright premium Athar service hall with a giant wall display reading 'UAE × LEBANON · 1M ATHAR USERS' beside the ATHAR logo, an Emirati and a Lebanese team member handing a tablet to a family, a wheelchair user at a kiosk, both flags flanking the display; C) elegant 3D glass-and-gold map of the Gulf and Eastern Mediterranean with dense glowing user nodes over the UAE and Lebanon joined by a navy-and-gold arc, ATHAR logo top centre, hero numeral '1M', a row of diverse user portraits, both flags at the ends. (b) Reference-guided edit: use the current concept render uploaded in this chat (canvas-screenshot-567x435.png, URL <signed URL not stored>) as the logo and brand-style reference and reimagine it as a far more powerful hero with the same ATHAR logo, both flags and a large '1M ATHAR USERS · UAE × LEBANON' display, dropping the 'PRODUCT CONCEPT' tab, the 'CONCEPT RENDER' caption and any UI artefacts. Return every image URL.
